what: Smooths out sudden jumps in a signal, so it glides to a new value instead of snapping. Use it for glide between notes, softened steps or slow-moving controls.
how: When the input rises, the output follows slowly, taking about RISE seconds to get most of the way there. When the input falls, FALL does the same job. A signal that jumps (a pitch from SEQ, a pulse) becomes a curve. Longer times smooth more; at 0 the signal passes straight through.

ins.in: The signal to smooth. Patch a pitch from SEQ or KEYS for glide, or a stepped signal from S&H for gentle movement.

outs.out: The smoothed signal. Patch it where the original would have gone.

knobs.rise: How slowly the output follows when the input goes up, 0 to 2 seconds. 0 is instant.
knobs.fall: How slowly the output follows when the input goes down, 0 to 2 seconds. 0 is instant.

try: Patch SEQ's pitch into SLEW's in and SLEW's out into VCO's pitch. Turn RISE and FALL up to about a quarter of the way and hear the notes slide into each other.
